messages:
rebecca (recruiter): FYI — after yesterday's ATS migration some interviewers are showing as untrained and their scorecard links 404 when they open them. spotted when scheduling round 2 for several candidates. :confused:

maria (people-ops): ugh. is this across all teams or only some interviewer cohorts? any commonality (new hires, role changes)?

rebecca (recruiter): seems concentrated to folks who had role updates in the HR sync window (title changes last week). examples: I-112, I-145, I-203 — all had recent manager/title edits.

oliver (trainer): that matches a schema migration in the sync that renamed `role_id` -> `primary_role`. If the training service expects `role_id` to compute qualified interviewers it might fall back to empty and unset the trained flag. we saw similar in staging earlier.

sana (recruiter): blocking: two panels tomorrow morning where interviewers can't access scorecards. can we short-term repoint them to the fallback form URL?

rebecca (recruiter): confirmed fallback form works if you paste the old link, but we need the UI link fixed for non-technical interviewers.

dev-bot: automated event: ats-migration-2026-04-12 completed at 2026-04-12T03:07:10Z, migrations=[role_rename,v2-schema], impacted_objects=1292

maria (people-ops): ok timeline: dev align with eng, get a targeted backfill for affected interviewer metadata, then run trainer recompute for impacted interviewers. we should notify hiring teams.

oliver (trainer): quick mitigation: I can run a script to recompute training status for a list of interviewer ids. please DM me the list and i'll run it within the hour. also will add a note to the interviewer training doc to check links after HR syncs.

kevin (eng): tagging in eng (kevin): the migration omitted a compatibility shim for `role_id`. i'll push a patch to map `primary_role` -> `role_id` when missing. also will add a one-off backfill job to repopulate `role_id` for records changed in the last 7 days. PR incoming.

rebecca (recruiter): putting together impacted interviewer list now — will drop in this thread in a sec. also filing REC-4981 for visibility and owner.

sana (recruiter): adding that two hiring managers need an explicit email so they can reassign if we don't fix within 3 hours.

rebecca (recruiter): affected interviewers pasted: I-112, I-145, I-203, I-211, I-250, I-269, I-277 (small panel coverage).

oliver (trainer): running recompute for those ids now. i'll post output in ~10m. command i run: `./tools/recalc_training --ids I-112,I-145,I-203,I-211,I-250,I-269,I-277 --dryrun=false`

dev-bot: job recalc_training_2519876600 started by oliver at 2026-04-12T09:20:00Z, status=running

oliver (trainer): run finished — trained badges restored for 6/7; I-269 still missing due to a stale profile (empty primary_role). flagged I-269 for manual HR review.

kevin (eng): patch merged that maps `primary_role` to `role_id` when `role_id` is missing. backfill job queued for last-7-days changes. will run now and report ETA.

maria (people-ops): thanks team. i'm sending a heads-up email to hiring managers and adding a checklist item to the post-migration runbook: "verify interviewer trained badges + scorecard links". also scheduling a 15m retro to tighten HR sync contracts.

rebecca (recruiter): verified with hiring managers — they can open scorecards now. thanks oliver and eng. please keep me posted about I-269.

oliver (trainer): I-269 flagged — outreach to HR assigned to @maria to correct role in profile so recompute picks it up.

maria (people-ops): on it. I'll update REC-4981 with resolution steps and close when HR fix + final recompute done.

rebecca (recruiter): great — appreciate the quick turnaround. adding a note to interviewer onboarding to double-check links after major schema changes. :thumbsup:
